sections.heading: Usha Mangeshkar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Usha Mangeshkar was born on 15 December 1935 in Indore, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Deenanath Mangeshkar. She is a sibling of Hridaynath Mangeshkar, Asha Bhosle, Meena Khadikar and Lata Mangeshkar.
She received her education at Balmohan Vidyamandir.
She is recorded as speaking Marathi, Meitei, Hindi and Bangla.
